title: Mitosis architecture audit and rebuild exploration

completion_criteria.text: Foundational audit of the current engine complete across all four domains: two-layer fan-out, durability/resume, cost/latency, pipeline rigidity + fragility
External research verdict delivered on whether the architecture is correct, with disconfirming pass and cited prior art
The child_process runtime-capability question settled empirically (does dynamic import of node:child_process EXECUTE inside a Workflow script, not merely resolve)

Three open architecture decisions resolved by the user: adopt an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime vs only its state model; default speculation depth given that rework costs tokens not machine time; which work-type pipelines to define first
An approved architecture spec for the rebuild exists, superseding or explicitly scoping the six paused repair-oriented mitosis threads

spine.active_goal: MSP A5 IN FLIGHT. origin/main re-derived at cad6ba2, green. 0162 re-read: A5 is characterization-only. 0188 resolved M5's restore-path residual INERT by exhaustive enumeration. 0189 narrowed A5 by mutation to five unpinned gaps on three untwinned targets. Branch test/a5-merge-poll-characterization cut at cad6ba2 in the main thread. Workflow wi3nyl4z1 (run wf_52e7fa01-8fa) dispatched: Ground/Design/Implement/Verify x3/Remediate cap 2/Ship, carrying the coverage-receipt gate verbatim.
spine.next_step: AWAIT workflow wi3nyl4z1. On completion read its shipped flag. If false it HALTED before ship with findings that survived two remediation rounds - read them, do not re-dispatch blindly. If true, confirm the PR opened, watch CI to green, leave merge to the user. THEN M5 is unblocked on both preconditions and is next: quiescent exit plus continuation block, deleting the bounded poll, progressPossible AND maxSteps (0185 moved that row to M5).
open_risks: DISPATCH-PROMPT GAP that cost a prior session a red CI: every PR must COMMIT docs/invariants/coverage/<branch>.json with a verdict for ALL 12 registry ids. The PR-mode gate reads git diff merge-base..HEAD and cannot see untracked paths; it never checks whether a check string is TRUE (0143).

NEW from 0188: the isBuiltResume restore call at mitosis.js:4586 passes only builtRef, so the sha-verification block at :4572-4579 never runs there, while the frontier redispatch at :4592 passes requireSha true. Not a bypass - a weaker check inside a call that happens. Assign to M5's owner.
supersedeOpenPr (mitosis.js:4386-4421) is DEAD CODE with zero call sites tree-wide (0188). Not a live ship path; do not chase it again.
advance.toRestack is computed (reconcile.mjs:122/:130 + twin) and logged (mitosis.js:3996) with ZERO consumers - a relaunch reports restacks it will not perform. Assigned to M5, not hotfixed (0187).

M5's scope is THREE deletions not two: the bounded poll, progressPossible, AND maxSteps (leases.mjs:170/172, mitosis.js:2382/2384), which 0185 moved out of M3 because the step bound is all that bounds the tick loop until the quiescent exit exists.
The M6 I4 contract flip (0186) is recorded ONLY in the ledger and a coverage receipt - PR #30's body never named it and the PR is MERGED, so no in-band remedy remains.

0182's revisit trigger HAS FIRED: A3's characterization file was repointed at the unified loop, not deleted, so its 76 percent duplicated fixture helpers are long-lived. A5's new file may inherit the same duplication - watch for it.
M4 stays THREATENED by 174a0dc: three behavior changes plus the structural publishedSpecPath share one commit range and three characterization tests were rewritten in it.
computeLogicalRunId still hashes only spec path + baseBranch (0176), so a superseded manifest ref is never reaped. Accepted, not silently carried.
published.sourcePrefix is logged on disagreement but does not WIN (0179). A relaunch under a different prefix can re-ship shipped work.
PR scope is FROZEN at creation; title/body edits are denied, later facts go in a comment (0142). pr-create rejects angle brackets in a --what value - reword, never force.

NEVER invoke the compiled workflow. mergePoll has no seam narrower than the full AsyncFunction harness: a bare const at mitosis.js:5057 passed as runSchedule's third positional arg at :5099-5108. MITOSIS_PATH swaps in a mutated scratch copy for inertness proofs.
A red result from a hand-rolled shell one-liner is suspect BEFORE the code is - re-run it in node.

Landing stays SERIAL for mitosis.js and the mirror census; a policed-twin edit lands in BOTH copies in one commit. reconcile.mjs AND leases.mjs are both WHOLE mirrors. A5 touches no twin (0189). Parallelize investigation, never landing.

ORCHESTRATION: cut the branch in the main thread BEFORE dispatching (done for A5); never pair a branch-switching agent with one reading the working tree. Writes under .claude/{hooks,rules,lib,workflows} need per-write approval, so wi3nyl4z1 WILL prompt.

Five pre-existing dirty paths persist (.claude/settings.json, .zshrc, two .bak files, .claude/skills/context7-mcp/) - stage explicit paths only, NEVER git add -A. 17 worktree entries remain live; no reaper verb.
Spec/plan anchors remain stale wholesale (0148 rejected a standalone rewrite). Re-baseline by execution per MSP. Section 10's M3 row and section 8 row 2 are inaccurate (0185).

Standing method rule, now SEVEN instances deep (0159, 0163, 0181, 0184, 0188, 0189): verify a confident finding against the mechanism before acting. 0189's scope came from MUTATION, not from reading for absence - reading would have written two redundant tests.
out_of_scope: Any change at mitosis.js:4058-4061. H-C is REFUTED by 0159, not deferred - the done-union is correct and narrowing it is a liveness regression. Re-opening needs new evidence of an unconfirmed-ship producer.
Removing or weakening the veto at mitosis.js:3787. It is the resurrection guard (0160); frontier-train-e2e.test.mjs:578 forbids it. M2 names and logs it, nothing more.
Un-ignoring docs/superpowers/plans/ wholesale, and git add -f as the tracking mechanism - both rejected by 0158 in favour of the /* plus negation form.
Track A / continuity-ledger-plugin until all mitosis MSPs are delivered (0136). A-1, A-2, A-3 and the Track A half of Wave 0 are DEFERRED, not abandoned.
Any further B-6 work. Implemented, merged and green; the invariant is discharged. Re-opening needs a new reason, not a re-read.
Rewriting the specs' 78 anchors as a standalone effort - rejected by 0148. Re-baseline by execution per MSP instead.
Executing run-readiness-repair's MSP-0..MSP-10. Quiescent-advance M0..M8 lands first, and the overlap (M0/M1 against MSP-6/MSP-7) must be reconciled before that spec is scheduled.
Pipelines for refactor, perf, docs or chore - closed by 0118. Limits PIPELINES only, not the PR title type vocabulary.
The feat pipeline - 0110 sequences it second, after the fix pipeline proves the effector boundary.
Speculation depth above 1 - 0109 requires a restack proven for the fix work type first.
Bootstrapping a target repo's test infrastructure as a side effect of shipping - closed by 0117; that is verify-setup, human-invoked.
Adopting an off-the-shelf durable-execution runtime - closed by 0108. A webhook, server or daemon for the relaunch trigger - closed by 0119.
fileScope-only task-edge derivation - rejected by 0116, settled by 0120.
Cluster-aware scheduling and the journal's 2000-char model-output paging - fenced out by spec section 1.
Dispatching or restarting any target-repo mitosis run.
Opening a pull request for docs/mitosis-core-rebuild-spec - the user ruled on 2026-07-30 that leaving it without a PR is fine.
